notes.title: Game Name Changed + Surprise - READ IT!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

As you may notice, My Giant Friend has changed its name to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122360/Giant_Wishes]Giant Wishes[/url]. The reason for it is that the game will be launched on consoles!

I'm so excited about it and in order to avoid legal problems with the big TV franchise My Giant Friend, the publisher and I decided to change the game name.

Thank you all for your compression and join Discord to get the news about the game sequel!

I hope you enjoy my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/h-room/list/56436]upcoming releases[/url] too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1907630/Beauties_Academy__Spellcraft_Tournament/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1775050/Hentai_Cast_Podcast_Simulator/

Don't forget to join [url=https://discord.gg/wQJvzpW]Discord[/url] to get the latest news, and don’t forget to follow my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/h-room]Steam page[/url].

notes.title: New Languages for My Giant Friend
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36662326/53a61d1f8cec1dfc3b2fd8466a80cdc40e4f4cf0.jpg[/img]

We're glad to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122360/My_Giant_Friend/]My Giant Friend[/url] will receive two new languages: Turkish and Spanish (Latin America). Turkia and Argentina have been receiving us with arms wide open and we want to thank you all for supporting the game. The update will happen on December 22th.
